div.div: حَسْوَةٌ A single act of supping or sipping; (S, * K;) as also ↓ حُسْوَةٌ ; but the former is the more chaste: (K:) some say that these are dial. vars., like نَغْبَةٌ and نُغْبَةٌ, and جَرْعَةٌ and جُرْعَةٌ: but accord. to Yoo, the former denotes the act, and the latter is the [proper] subst. (TA.) See also what next follows.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
